It tilts its head toward the window — outside, the station sign begins sliding backward as the bus starts; <Subject 1> sways slightly with inertia, its dot eyes widening a little.

<Subject 1> now kneels on the seat, both paws gripping the window sill, its round face nearly pressed to the glass, small nose flattened into a tiny oval. Its breath fogs a faint patch on the glass that quickly fades away.
